防災1902UAL 232 / LZ 129 / ANDREA DORIA / HAKKODA1989

Chapter 4 — Mount Hakkōda

The March into the Blizzard

1902.01.23　AOMORI → TASHIRO

This work is based on the disaster of January 1902 (Meiji 35), when the 5th Infantry Regiment of Aomori was lost on Mount Hakkōda during a snow-march training exercise. Of the 210 men who took part, 199 died.

It was made with respect for those who died, so that you can walk through it and see with your own eyes what happened that day. The protagonist and some characters and conversations are fictional. Dates, numbers and the course of the march are based on sources such as Wikipedia and news reports.

This game depicts severe cold, frostbite, and the deaths of many people. If you have been through a painful experience with an accident or disaster, please don’t push yourself.
